title: Nokia expands partnerships with TIM Brasil, Deutsche Telekom in AI technology push
title_zh: 诺基亚扩大与 TIM Brasil 和德国电信的合作伙伴关系，推动人工智能技术的发展
summary: March 2 (Reuters) - Nokia said on Monday it was expanding partnerships with TIM Brasil and Deutsche Telekom, as the Finnish 5G gear maker seeks to capitalise on adoption of AI-based technologies
summary_zh: 3 月 2 日（路透社）——诺基亚周一表示，正在扩大与 TIM Brasil 和德国电信的合作伙伴关系，这家芬兰 5G 设备制造商寻求利用基于人工智能的技术

title: Stocks Slump as US-Iran War Lifts Brent Toward $80: Markets Wrap
title_zh: 美伊战争将布伦特原油推向 80 美元，股市暴跌：市场收尾
summary: Brent crude traded near $80 a barrel after the conflict effectively shut the Strait of Hormuz — a vital artery off Iran’s coast that carries about a fifth of the world’s oil and significant volumes of gas.
summary_zh: 冲突导致霍尔木兹海峡关闭后，布伦特原油价格接近每桶 80 美元。霍尔木兹海峡是伊朗海岸附近的一条重要动脉，运载着世界上约五分之一的石油和大量天然气。

title: Amazon Cloud Disrupted After ‘Objects’ Hit UAE Data Center
title_zh: “物体”袭击阿联酋数据中心后亚马逊云中断
summary: AWS said the incident, which took place around 4:30 p.m. Dubai time on Sunday, impacted services from the data center in one of its regional groups.
summary_zh: AWS 表示，该事件发生在下午 4:30 左右。迪拜时间周日，其一个区域集团的数据中心的服务受到影响。

title: Vodafone teams up with Amazon's satellites to connect masts in Europe and Africa
title_zh: 沃达丰与亚马逊卫星合作连接欧洲和非洲的桅杆
summary: Mobile company Vodafone said on Monday it had ‌signed a deal with Amazon ‌Leo, the U.S. company's low Earth orbit satellite network, ​to connect 4G and 5G mobile masts in remote areas in Europe and Africa.
summary_zh: 移动公司沃达丰周一表示，它已与美国公司的近地轨道卫星网络亚马逊 Leo 签署了一项协议，以连接欧洲和非洲偏远地区的 4G 和 5G 移动基站。

title: Amazon's AWS reports power, connectivity issues in Bahrain, UAE amid Iran strikes
title_zh: 亚马逊 AWS 报告伊朗袭击期间巴林和阿联酋出现电力和连接问题
summary: Amazon cloud unit's data centers in Bahrain and the UAE were facing ‌power and connectivity issues on Monday, the ‌company said, as Iranian retaliatory strikes hit airports, ports, and ​residential areas across the wider Gulf.
summary_zh: 该公司表示，随着伊朗的报复性袭击袭击了整个海湾地区的机场、港口和住宅区，亚马逊云部门位于巴林和阿联酋的数据中心周一面临电力和连接问题。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures plunge while oil prices surge as Iran conflict jolts markets
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货暴跌，而伊朗冲突震撼市场，油价飙升
summary: Wall Street is reacting to joint attacks from the US and Israel on Iran, which has spurred a retreat from risk assets.
summary_zh: 华尔街正在对美国和以色列对伊朗的联合攻击做出反应，这引发了风险资产的撤退。

title: NFL quarterback Jameis Winston on how he turned from burning through cash to investing strategically
title_zh: NFL 四分卫杰梅斯·温斯顿 (Jameis Winston) 讲述他如何从烧钱转向战略投资
summary: Winston's costly evolution is a reminder to "be where your feet are" and invest in companies you know.
summary_zh: 温斯顿代价高昂的演变提醒我们“脚踏实地”并投资于您认识的公司。
